<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: Jacob Paul Construction. -->

# DESIGN.md — Jacob Paul Construction

stylesheet: assets/site.css
archetype: craft-trusted
rationale: >
  A licensed general contractor in Danbury, CT needs a clean, confident presence that conveys
  reliability and craftsmanship — deep navy-slate (#1c3d5a) for trust, warm amber (#d4912a)
  accents for energy and craft, and Sora/Manrope typography deliver authority without
  feeling corporate or cold.
interaction_level: L2

personality: [reliable, skilled, straightforward, professional, approachable]

typography:
  display: "Sora"
  body: "Manrope"
  scale: 1.25
  notes: >
    Display (Sora) for nav, headlines, CTAs, and card titles — 600–800 weight.
    Body (Manrope) for paragraphs and form fields. Hero h1 uses clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 3.85rem)
    / 800, tracked −0.02em. Section titles clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.7rem) / 800.
    Eyebrows in Sora 700, ~12–13px, letter-spacing 0.12em, uppercase, gold accent (#d4912a).
    Body ~1.05–1.06rem / 1.55–1.7 line-height in --text / --text-mid.
    Pill CTAs use Sora 700. No serifs.

palette:
  primary: "#1c3d5a"
  primary_dark: "#0f2a40"
  accent: "#d4912a"
  tint: "#edf2f7"
  tint_alt: "#f5f7fa"
  ink: "#0e1f2e"
  text: "#1a2a36"
  text_mid: "#4a5a66"
  secondary_surface: "#edf2f7"
  application: >
    Brand #1c3d5a is the primary CTA fill, section accents, links, and scrolled-header CTA.
    Brand-dark #0f2a40 is the footer ground and deeper hover. Amber #d4912a for eyebrows,
    hero kicker, service bullets, and star ratings. Tint bands (#edf2f7 / #f5f7fa) for
    alternating sections (services, FAQ, soft cards). Hero uses a full-bleed construction
    photo with dark navy scrim gradients for white type. White (#ffffff) for type on dark
    surfaces, hero primary CTA fill, and card interiors. Green (#22c55e / #e7f7ee) for
    open-hours badges where present.

composition:
  whitespace: generous
  photography: hero
  card_usage: selective
  mobile: >
    Fixed header: text logo left (white over hero; brand when scrolled), burger right.
    Mobile panel slides from the right with logo, section links, and call CTA.
    Hero locked to 100svh; content bottom-aligned; typography and button padding tighten on
    small viewports / short heights so CTAs stay above the fold. Services grid stacks;
    about becomes single column; contact form stacks over info/map. Footer columns stack.

shell:
  header: >
    Fixed over the hero, transparent until scroll (>24px), then frosted white
    (rgba(255,255,255,.92)) with soft brand shadow. Text logo "Jacob Paul Construction"
    at left with hardhat icon. Desktop nav: About, Services, Reviews, FAQ, Contact — Sora
    600 15px; plus outlined phone pill and solid "Get a Free Quote" CTA. Scrolled state
    flips nav to ink/brand colors and brand-filled CTA.
  nav: ["About", "Services", "Reviews", "FAQ", "Contact"]
  footer: >
    Background #0f2a40. Four groups on desktop (brand + rating; Explore; Services; Get in touch),
    stacked on mobile. Brand block uses text logo + short practice line + Google
    rating. Explore and Services are in-page anchor links. Get in touch shows address, phone,
    email. Bottom bar: © year and serving line.

pages:
  - slug: index
    title: "Jacob Paul Construction – Licensed General Contractor in Danbury, CT"
    description: "Jacob Paul Construction is a licensed general contractor in Danbury, Connecticut. Custom homes, renovations, roofing, concrete, and commercial construction serving Fairfield County."
    intent: "Primary conversion page — request a free quote"
    takes: [hero, about, services, reviews, faq, contact]

sections:
  - id: hero
    layout: full-bleed-overlay
    show: index
    spec: >
      Full viewport height (100vh / 100svh). Background construction site photo,
      object-fit cover. Dual scrim gradients for legibility. Bottom-left content:
      kicker "Danbury, CT · Licensed General Contractor"; h1 "Built right. Built to last.";
      supporting sentence; CTAs "Get a Free Quote" and "Our Services".

  - id: about
    layout: split-visual
    show: index
    spec: >
      White ground. Left: team/site photo with brand-tint backdrop and credentials card.
      Right: eyebrow, section title, two leads, four checkmark feature chips.

  - id: services
    layout: numbered-card-grid
    show: index
    spec: >
      Tint ground. Header with eyebrow, title, lead. Six service cards in responsive grid.

  - id: reviews
    layout: sidebar-plus-cards
    show: index
    spec: >
      White ground. Left sidebar with rating summary; right: three review cards.

  - id: faq
    layout: accordion
    show: index
    spec: >
      Soft tint ground. Accordion list. First item open by default.

  - id: contact
    layout: split-form
    show: index
    spec: >
      White / tint split. Left: quote request form. Right: visit details.

assets:
  stylesheet_live: assets/site.css
  stylesheet_alias: assets/styles.css
  tokens_source: src/input.css

avoid:
  - purple-on-white / purple-to-indigo AI default themes
  - warm cream + terracotta editorial cliche
  - inset or carded hero images — hero must stay full-bleed
  - stats strips or promo chips overlaid on hero media
  - inventing contact details beyond the known address, phone, and email
  - construction cliches ("state-of-the-art", "cutting-edge")
  - loading conflicting legacy stylesheets on index that override site tokens
